mentions.name: Stair lift for goods
mentions.description: A cargo stair lift for stuff rather than people that retrofits onto any stairs and self-locks without damaging the stairs or blocking the path. It moves groceries, laundry, senior dogs, and other items up and down stairs at the push of a button and can currently pull 50 lbs.
mentions.source_excerpt: - A stair lift for stuff, not people. Retrofits onto any stairs and self-locks without damaging the stairs or blocking the path. Allows you to bring groceries, laundry, senior dogs up and down stairs with the push of a button. Currently can pull 50lbs.
